digest.component_or_area: Jira family adapter user identity contract
propositions: Cloud and Data Center identify users differently (accountId vs name), requiring a pluggable identity model to avoid leaking deployment-specific logic into core diff
PR #120's implementation returns authoritative=False unconditionally for Data Center due to unreachable getattr-discovered resolver branch, causing assignee-diff churn on every pass

UserIdentityModel protocol with resolve() and to_payload() implementations (AccountIdIdentity for Cloud, NameIdentity for DC) must enable real DC user-search lookup to achieve authoritative=True convergence

NameIdentity must perform actual lookup against DC user-search endpoint rather than echo local value, so unresolvable assignees raise BackendAssigneeNotFoundError instead of silently returning non-authoritative state
Identity model implementations receive resolver as explicit constructor parameter (not optional getattr-discovered attribute) to eliminate unreachable code branches
